posts.content:
Pleasantville Secondary School marked its 50th anniversary with a tea party and fashion show, “Blushes of Elegance”, at the Petrotrin Staff Club in Pointe-à-Pierre on Saturday, September 26.
Students traded their school uniforms for fashionable attire as they took to the runway under the creative direction of Jaqui Koonhow and stylist Larry Rampersad.
